issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement names the class 'Course' while the exercise text and template use 'Lecture'. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected class name and constructor: they might try to implement a Course constructor or follow the UML name instead of creating/implementing Lecture, leading to compilation errors or incorrect implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the UML class from 'Course' to 'Lecture' in problem_statement.md so it matches the exercise text, template, and solution. Ensure any references to constructor examples or UML labels use 'Lecture' to avoid ambiguity.
